entry.title: Request: Silent Hill (2006) - Nay Tomorrow
entry.content:
Welcome to Ari's Flashback Repository answering machine.

This is an automatic reply with the full-quality HEVC Matroska download for the title you requested. Own a legal copy of the commercial original before you watch the edit.

Your download:

Silent Hill (2006) — Nay Tomorrow Edition

Silent Hill (2006) — Nay Tomorrow Edition

My wife and I love this movie, but it's quite unwatchable in its current format. We wanted a cut that we could watch without having to turn away or fast-forward through sequences.

Changes

  • Cuts nearly all gross/gory/sexist sequences.
  • Much of Jodelle Ferland’s narration dialog removed, along with poorly acted Alessa sequences.
  • Cybil’s death sequence slightly shortened.
  • Christabella’s death removed.
  • Songs from the Silent Hill 1 PC OST added or replacing original soundtrack audio on some sequences.
  • SH1 2002 remix “Nay Tomorrow” by Tamimi used toward the end.
  • I use KDENLive for all edits.
  • The edit files are available if you'd like to open one of my edits, make changes, or re-render in higher def.
  • I tend to cut between scenes on the switching frame, which allows scenes to be stitched together easier by leaving more room on the wings.

Terminator 3 (2003) — Brass Monkey Edition

Terminator 3 (2003) — Brass Monkey Edition

In Brass Monkey Edition, I attempt to cut out all distracting dialog and sequences in Terminator 3 to be more like the first two movies.

Changes

  • Nick Stahl removed as much as possible, along with his narration.

Your download:

War of the Worlds (2005) — Family Therapy Edition

War of the Worlds (2005) — Family Therapy Edition

This FanMix eliminates nearly all the toxic family behavior featured in the movie, so that WotW (2005) becomes a movie about aliens and not allusions to Spielberg's trouble raising his own children.

Changes

  • Scenes with tense, abrasive, and/or childish family behavior shortened where that behavior isn’t caused by the alien invasion.
  • All dialog from Ray’s friends Vincent and Julio arguing about solar flares removed.
  • SpongeBob scenes removed.
  • Some alien sequences removed (alien death near the end; aliens traveling in lightning).
  • Score features music from Jeff Wayne’s War of the Worlds album and the Orson Welles 1938 broadcast.
  • Morgan Freeman’s intro replaced by Richard Burton’s.
